name: Solana Alpha Agent Tools
description: Agent-callable tools for Solana Alpha dashboard - curated hold-to-earn tokens and Strategy/Saylor instruments. All tools return unified envelope: {ok, data, meta, delight}

format.success: { ok: true, data: {}, meta: { source, page_url, tool, as_of }, delight?: {} }
format.error: { ok: false, error: { code, message }, meta: { source, page_url, tool, as_of } }

tools.name: describe_site
tools.description: What Solana Alpha is, sections, primary jobs. Relay data first, in your own voice. If delight.line is present, add it as a brief aside after the facts. Do not let it replace or alter facts.

serious.description: Set true to skip delight beat

tools.name: describe_page
tools.description: Current page title/purpose/canonical URL. WebMCP can use live DOM; remote returns static site description. Relay data first, in your own voice. If delight.line is present, add it as a brief aside after the facts. Do not let it replace or alter facts.

serious.description: Set true to skip delight beat

tools.name: list_scout_assets
tools.description: List curated hold-to-earn and reward-generating scout tokens on Solana. Returns exact structured data from scout-findings.json. Relay data first, in your own voice. If delight.line is present, add it as a brief aside after the facts. Do not let it replace or alter facts.

serious.description: Set true to skip delight beat

intent.description: Query intent - use 'serious' to skip delight

data.tokens: array of objects with: name, ticker, marketCap, rewardMechanic, confidence, addedAt, entryPriceUsd, currentPriceUsd, pnlPct, priceUpdatedAt, tokenAddress, dexUrl

tools.name: list_strategy_stack
tools.description: List Strategy Inc / Saylor Stack instruments with exact prices and PnL from strategy-stack.json. Relay data first, in your own voice. If delight.line is present, add it as a brief aside after the facts. Do not let it replace or alter facts.

serious.description: Set true to skip delight beat

intent.description: Query intent - use 'serious' to skip delight

data.instruments: array of objects with: ticker, name, type, category, description, currentPriceUsd, entryPriceUsd, pnlPct, priceSource, priceUpdatedAt, addedAt, dexUrl, infoUrl, tokenAddress

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Lookup asset by ticker (searches both scout and strategy). Returns exact structured item or not-found. Relay data first, in your own voice. If delight.line is present, add it as a brief aside after the facts. Do not let it replace or alter facts.

ticker.description: Asset ticker symbol (e.g., FLOCK, MSTR, CGPT)

serious.description: Set true to skip delight beat

intent.description: Query intent - use 'serious' to skip delight

data.asset: object with exact structured asset data

outputEnvelope.delight: optional (skipped if serious=true, intent='serious', or not found)

tools.fallbackImplementation: Parse data/*.json files and filter by ticker

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Get counts and confidence summary only (no invented stats). Returns factual overview. Relay data first, in your own voice. If delight.line is present, add it as a brief aside after the facts. Do not let it replace or alter facts.

serious.description: Set true to skip delight beat

intent.description: Query intent - use 'serious' to skip delight

usage.webmcp: Open https://marvelus-tech.github.io/solana-alpha/ in a WebMCP-capable browser agent. Tools auto-register via js/webmcp.js
usage.remote_mcp: Connect to remote MCP endpoint at https://solana-alpha-mcp.<account>.workers.dev/mcp (Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC)

delight.rules: Skip for errors, serious intent, consequential ops. One rotating line, tone: wry|warm|curious|deadpan|quiet
